reviewMethod: All 22 selected stored files across five newest eligible current-corpus ACS articles were independently rehashed against the fresh read-only GitHub evidence artifact and checked for exact task/page/article/source DOI identity, original Figure/Scheme identity and independent caption, captureVersion 6.2.20, job identity, fixed media generation 1790082000000, content-addressed R2 key, actual byte length/type/dimensions, duplicate source/hash ownership, frozen public same-ID state and existing official TOC separation. Twenty-one SVG files were rendered and checked for active/external content; the PNG was decoded and dimension-checked. Every image was visually reviewed against its owning caption and article theme for body-image role, unrelated/recommendation contamination, duplicate risk and legibility. Capture success and transport checkpoints were treated only as provenance evidence. No publisher request, R2/D1 write, direct import/repair, literature/card/title/scope mutation, userscript change or media-generation change was performed.
quality: The 22 files are exact stored bytes (21 self-contained SVG and 1 PNG), all within configured size bounds, with unique selected full SHA256 and source identities. Frozen public media-index records contain no same-ID body figures for these five DOI; each article has a distinct existing official TOC which remains untouched. Figure 1 is body-only and is not a TOC substitution. Final article reports state 5/5, 4/4, 6/6, 3/3 and 4/4 captured respectively. Earlier transport or format checkpoints are retained as provenance and are not attributed to VPN, R2, quota or another cause without evidence.
